name: AtomStack A24 Ultra
tagline: Step-up A24 with more diode power and refined hybrid workflow
tldr: AtomStack A24 Ultra is the higher-tier A24 with more diode power and updated hybrid layout. Same use case as A24 Pro — metal marking plus organic work in a compact box — with more headroom for cutting.
mainObjective: Premium compact hybrid Atomstack for metal + wood shops

proTips: Dedicated fixtures matter for repeat metal jobs.
primaryUse: Compact hybrid production for mixed material personalization.
